   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

           CARBONEUM OXYGENISATUM

         Carbonous Oxide


Herpes zoster, pemphigus, and trismus are produced by this drug.
        Coldness,   sleepiness  , loss of consciousness are marked.
        Vertigo.



Head.--  Cerebral congestion; hallucination of vision, hearing
        and touch. Inclination to turn in a circle.   Jaws firmly clenched  .
        Trismus. Heaviness of head. Sticking pain in temples. Roaring ears.



Eyes.--  Ocular paralysis, hemianopsias, disturbed pupillary
        reaction, optic neuritis and atrophy, subconjunctival and retinal hæmorrhages.



Skin.--  Anæsthesia; vesication along course of nerves;   herpes zoster  ; pemphigus, with large and small vesicles. Hand
        icy cold.



Sleep.--  Deep.   Prolonged  ;
        sleepiness for several days.



Dose.--  First attenuation.
